name: Test by Bikram | General Aptitude | Test 2

question.text:
My sister is getting ______ her studies quite well.

Fill in the blank with the appropriate word: 

  1. round
  2. over
  3. at
  4. on

Find the missing letter in the following table:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|} \hline N & 126 & R \\ \hline T & 100 & Y \\ \hline Y & 50 & P \\ \hline K & 12 & L \\ \hline G & 13 & ? \\ \hline \end{array}$$

  1. Y
  2. X
  3. Q
  4. Z

Price of commodities X & Y increases by $40$ paise and $15$ paise every year, respectively. In $2001$, the price of commodity X was ₹$4.20$ and that of Y was  ₹$6.30$.

In which year will commodity X cost $40$ paise more than commodity Y?

  1. $2010$
  2. $2011$
  3. $2012$
  4. $2013$

Find the grammatically INCORRECT sentence:

  1. The scenery of Kashmir is awesome.
  2. I need three hairs of a black horse.
  3. The furnitures in the shop are expensive.
  4. I have no more information.

Vidya always complained about breakfast. Her mother tried everything, but she was unhappy. Vidya once went to a super market and bought one of the ready-to-cook packets. She cooked the packets on her own and found the breakfast to be delicious.

Choose the best supporting statement:

  1. Practice makes a man perfect.
  2. The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be ignited.
  3. Smart work is the key to success.
  4. Nothing gives as much satisfaction as earning our own rewards.

Find a synonym for the word “GAOL”:

  1. Destination
  2. Jail
  3. Bail
  4. Enthusiasm

If you take the first right after the stadium, you come to the Reebok showroom; if you take the second ___________ to the left after that, you come to the building where my office is.

  1. turn up
  2. turn in
  3. turn
  4. turning

Monica had a well paying contract with a television advertiser of Indian Tourism, so she didn't want a fall out  _________ the company.

  1. over
  2. under
  3. of
  4. with

A jar full of juice contains $60 \%$ sugar. A part of this juice is replaced by another containing $22 \%$ sugar and now the percentage of sugar was found to be $42 \%$. The quantity of juice replaced is:

  1. $10/19$
  2. $9/19$
  3. $9/10$
  4. $10/9$

From a group of $6$ men and $5$ women, $4$ persons are to be selected to form a committee such that at least $2$ men are in the committee. In how many ways it can be done?

  1. $150$
  2. $250$
  3. $265$
  4. $115$

Aluminium : Bauxite :: Iron :

  1. Pyrite
  2. Lignite
  3. Hematite
  4. Steatite

A number $1$5 is divided into three parts which are in A.P. and the sum of their squares is $83$.

The highest part is:

  1. $3$
  2. $5$
  3. $6$
  4. $7$

Choose the appropriate antonym for the word given below:
ABOMINATE

  1. loathe
  2. despise
  3. adore
  4. abhor

Replace the phrase inside the quotation marks:
Construction of the Roman Colosseum, $\textit{"which was officially known as the Flavian Amphitheater, began in A.D.69, during the reign of Vespasian," }$ was completed a decade later, during the reign of Titus, who opened the Colosseum with a one-hundred-day cycle of religious pageants, gladiatorial games, and spectacles.

  1. which was officially known as the Flavian Amphitheater, began in A.D. $69$, during the reign of Vespasian,
  2. officially known as the Flavian Amphitheater, begun in A.D. $69$, during the reign of Vespasian, and
  3. which was officially known as the Flavian Amphitheater, began in A.D. $69$, during the reign of Vespasian, and
  4. officially known as the Flavian Amphitheater and begun in A.D. $69$, during the reign of Vespasian it

Melt : Liquid

  1. Heat : Vapour
  2. Water : Liquid
  3. Freeze : Cold
  4. Liquid : Ice

Atif  _________ popular musician in Mumbai.

  1. is a most
  2. is an
  3. is the
  4. is the most

Choose the grammatically wrong one among the following sentences:

  1. The young will support the nation.
  2. We like to clean the house in spring.
  3. He is a honest person.
  4. Each student was present in the hall.

____________ was devastated due to the tsunami in Tamil Nadu.

  1. Towns after towns
  2. Town after towns
  3. Towns after town
  4. Town after town
There are $5$ hotels on a road. If $4$ men go into the hotel at $11$ am, then the probability that each go into a different hotel is ______.

The company can’t expect me to move my house $\textbf{“at the drop of a hat "}$.

The proper meaning of the phrase marked in quotations is:

  1. Hesitatingly
  2. Abnormally
  3. Immediately
  4. Lately

Choose the word which means “a critical situation in which no progress can be made” :

  1. Hullabaloo
  2. Aggression
  3. Histrionic
  4. Impasse

The difference of $2$ numbers is $4245$. On dividing the larger number by the smaller, we get $8$ as quotient and the $45$ as remainder. What is the smaller number?

  1. $700$
  2. $600$
  3. $240$
  4. $500$

“ I wish I knew Bengali.”  In this sentence, the speaker:

  1. Wants to learn Bengali.
  2. Does not know Bengali.
  3. Knows Bengali very well.
  4. Knew Bengali in the past.

A dishonest shopkeeper marks up the price of his goods by $20 \%$ and gives a discount of $10 \%$ to the customer. Besides, he also cheats both his supplier and his buyer by $100$ grams while buying and selling $1$ kilogram. Find the percentage profit earned by the shopkeeper.

  1. $31 \%$
  2. $32 \%$
  3. $35 \%$
  4. $29 \%$

Below, there is a sentence of which some parts have been jumbled up. Rearrange these parts which are labelled P, Q, R, and S to produce a correct sentence and choose the proper sequence. It would :  

  1. appear from his statement
  2. about the policy of management
  3. in dealing with the strike
  4. that he was quite in the dark

The proper sequence is:

  1. RPSQ
  2. PSQR
  3. RQPS
  4. PRQS

The traffic lights at three different road crossings change every $16,24$ and $54$ seconds respectively. If they have changed simultaneously at $5$ AM, how many more times will they have changed simultaneously by $5:37$ AM?

  1. $7$
  2. $6$
  3. $8$
  4. $5$

Data concerning the effects on a small population of high concentrations of a potentially hazardous chemical are frequently used to _________ the effects on a large population of lower amounts of the same chemical.

  1. verify
  2. redress
  3. predict
  4. realize

Fake currency is being supplied to India through buses that run between India and Pakistan. What should be the next course of action?

  1. The govt. should ban the buses.
  2. The govt. should change the currency.
  3. The govt. should strengthen vigilance.
  4. Indian govt. should warn the Pakistani govt.

A contractor receives a certain sum that he uses for paying wages. His capital, together with the weekly subsidy, would just enable him to pay $42$ men for $52$ weeks. If he had $60$ men at the same wage, his capital together with the weekly subsidy would just suffice for $13$ weeks. How many men can he maintain for $26$ weeks?

  1. $48$
  2. $80$
  3. $68$
  4. $30$

A, B, and C worked together to complete a job in $10$ days. However, C only worked for the first three days when $37/100$ of the job was done. Also, the work done by A in $5$ days is equal to the work done by B in $4$ days. How many days would be required by the fastest worker to complete the entire job?

  1. $30$
  2. $28$
  3. $20$
  4. $45$
